quote: Our contributions are fourfold: (1) We introduce and define the concept of duplex models, which are designed to generate output simultaneously as they receive input.

We propose a framework for quickly converting current LLMs into duplex models by processing queries and responses pseudosimultaneously ... MiniCPM-duplex ... enables dynamic responses to user queries.

We introduce the concept of duplex models to address this limitation. Duplex models emulate human cognitive processes by synthesizing responses internally while simultaneously attending to incoming user inputs, akin to a person thinking while listening as well as speaking while observing.
